test_flash_gpt2_generate: test the flash GPT-2 model by generating text with max_new_tokens and decoder_input_details
test_flash_gpt2_load: test the flash GPT-2 model under load by generating multiple responses and validating determinism
run_flash_gpt2_fixture: run the flash_gpt2_handle fixture to launch the openai-community/gpt2 model with two shards
run_flash_gpt2_client: run the flash_gpt2 fixture to wait for model health and return the inference client
review_test_flash_gpt2: review the test_flash_gpt2 test to verify generated token count and response snapshot matching
